name: HIC-Bench
description:
HIC-Bench is a benchmark designed to distinguish Intelligent Hallucinations and Defective Hallucinations in creativity tasks.
	

Update: To facilitate access, the CDID.csv dataset has been temporarily merged with the CDKB.csv dataset.

	
		
		Overview of Datasets
	

This project includes two datasets: CDID.csv and CDKB.csv. These datasets provide detailed descriptions of innovative questions across various fields and their corresponding knowledge bases.
